audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 at 51.64% WR / 2072 games — skill matchup where Wind Wall blocks both her ranged Q and her R projectile; text covers it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 / First item rows were shifted by one slot: win[4]=Qiyana with whys[4] saying Yasuo spikes at 6, win[5]=Yasuo with whys[5] saying first item swings it back to you. Every prose field (spikes[1], spikes[2], mid, late) agrees the 6 spike is Yasuo's and first item is Qiyana's.
audit.why: Yasuo's Last Breath (70s CD) off a tornado is a genuine level-6 out-spike; Qiyana's first-item burst beats a shieldless Yasuo — the prose is kit-consistent, the chart row order is not.

Wind Wall blocking ranged Q and R shockwave, melee combo passing through, tornado-into-Last Breath, flow shield — all already stated. Added real CDs: Wind Wall 25s rank 1 / 17s max, 4s duration; Last Breath 70/50/30s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second invitation' on a 25s rank-1 Wind Wall.
dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles; dontsFull[1].d referenced 'a held stun' Yasuo does not have.
audit.why: Lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED; Yasuo's CC is the tornado knockup, not a held stun.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to match titles and kit.

notes: Chart correction is Medium confidence: content win[4]/win[5] (and the packet levelChart) said Level 6 = Qiyana, First item = Yasuo, while every prose field on both layers (whys[4], whys[5], spikes[1], spikes[2], mid) says the opposite — Yasuo's Last Breath spike owns level 6 and Qiyana's first item swings it back. I judged the rows shifted by one and flipped win[4]/win[5] with matching full-layer sides and whys; regression-check will confirm layer agreement. If the packet chart is considered authoritative over prose here, drop the win[4]/win[5]/phases[4]/phases[5] group. Wind Wall 'fifteen-second' magnitude fixed to the real 25s rank 1. Note Qiyana's R IS a projectile (kit flag) — existing tldr already warns Wind Wall eats it; dosFull[1].d rewrite keeps R usage keyed to terrain stun, which the wall cannot block once detonated on her side of it.
